list.name: paymentId
list.query: SELECT id FROM payments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, transaction_id, amount, currency, state, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE id = ${paymentId}
SELECT timestamp as "Time", event as "Event", from_state as "From State", to_state as "To State" FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT DISTINCT state as id, state as title FROM (SELECT from_state as state FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} UNION SELECT to_state FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId}) as nodes
SELECT id, from_state as source, to_state as target, event as mainStat FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId}
